rows.grounds: past participle passive of pra-vac, accusative singular neuter
compound of yāmala and sammatam, accusative singular neuter

items.question: What is the status of the supreme secret that has been declared?
items.inference: The verse presents the declared supreme secret as approved by Yamala.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yāmala is not specified.
items.plain_english: The supreme secret has been declared; thus it is approved by Yamala.
